meta.title: Specialty coffee in Strasbourg — Galista Café
meta.description: Galista Café, specialty coffee in Strasbourg: breakfasts, Turkish coffee, böreks, pastries and ice cream. 46 rue du Faubourg-National — discover the menu.

hero.subtitle: Specialty coffee, flavours from Istanbul and sweet treats — take a real break in the heart of Strasbourg.

univers.title: A place to savour the moment.
univers.text: Located in Strasbourg, Galista Café welcomes you in a warm, friendly atmosphere. From the first coffee of the morning to the gourmet break, discover a selection of drinks, pastries and specialities inspired by Istanbul.

carte.allergens_note: For any information about allergens, please ask our team.
carte.flavors: Vanilla, chocolate, crunchy chocolate, coffee, pistachio, strawberry, stracciatella, melon, lemon, mango, salted butter caramel, cookies, red berries, coconut.

petit_dej_classique.name: Classic breakfast
petit_dej_classique.desc: A simple, indulgent set to start the day right.
petit_dej_classique.ing: Crispy bread served with butter and jam or honey, along with a hot drink of your choice and fresh orange juice. A simple, complete way to ease into the day.

petit_dej_galista.name: Galista breakfast
petit_dej_galista.desc: A generous set combining savoury flavours with sweet touches.
petit_dej_galista.ing: A grand savoury-and-sweet platter: hard-boiled egg, shredded feta and emmental, salami, olives, juicy tomatoes and cucumbers, fresh herbs, honey or jam — all served with bread, a hot drink and orange juice. A generous Turkish-style feast.

omelette_aneth.name: Dill omelette
omelette_aneth.desc: Omelette made with two eggs and dill, served with bread.
omelette_aneth.ing: Two eggs gently pan-cooked and delicately flavoured with fresh dill for a subtle aniseed note. Soft inside, golden at the edges, served with bread.

omelette_tomate_fromage.name: Tomato and cheese omelette
omelette_tomate_fromage.desc: Omelette with tomatoes and emmental, served with bread.
omelette_tomate_fromage.ing: Two soft eggs filled with melted tomatoes and stretchy emmental, pan-fried until golden. Served with fresh bread for a simple, filling meal.

omelette_fromage.name: Cheese omelette
omelette_fromage.ing: A generous emmental omelette, cooked slowly to stay creamy at the centre, with a golden crust that smells of melted cheese.

omelette_simit.name: Simit omelette
omelette_simit.desc: A combination of eggs, simit and cheese.
omelette_simit.ing: A typically Istanbul combination: two eggs, pieces of sesame-crusted simit and melting emmental. Served hot — crispy and soft all at once.

menemen.name: Menemen
menemen.desc: Turkish speciality of scrambled eggs with tomatoes and peppers, served with bread.
menemen.ing: The great Turkish breakfast classic: eggs scrambled slowly with ripe tomatoes and soft, sweet peppers in olive oil. Enjoy it piping hot, with fresh bread to mop up every last drop.

oeufs_kavurma.name: Eggs with kavurma
oeufs_kavurma.desc: Two eggs served with simit and kavurma, a Turkish-style cooked meat.
oeufs_kavurma.ing: Two eggs served with kavurma — Turkish-style pan-cooked beef, lightly spiced and deeply flavourful — plus a crispy sesame simit. A hearty plate that keeps you going.

oeufs_sucuk.name: Eggs with sucuk
oeufs_sucuk.desc: Two eggs served with sucuk, a spicy Turkish sausage, and bread.
oeufs_sucuk.ing: Two eggs cooked with slices of sucuk, the Turkish sausage seasoned with garlic and chilli whose richness gently flavours the eggs. Served with bread for a complete, indulgent plate.

assiette_mezze.name: Mezze platter
assiette_mezze.ing: A small fresh platter to share: a selection of cheeses, crunchy tomatoes and cucumbers, and olives. Perfect as a starter or alongside a breakfast.

frites.name: Fries
frites.ing: Golden, crispy fries served hot with a pinch of salt. The perfect side dish — or something to nibble together.

supplement_fromage.name: Cheese extra
supplement_fromage.ing: An extra portion of cheese to enrich your omelette or plate: more melt, more flavour.

croissant_sale.name: Savoury croissant
croissant_sale.desc: A croissant filled with tomato, lettuce, cream cheese and salami.
croissant_sale.ing: A flaky croissant filled with tomato, crunchy lettuce, smooth cream cheese and salami. Golden puff pastry meets a fresh, savoury filling.

sandwich_simit_acma.name: Simit / açma sandwich
sandwich_simit_acma.desc: Turkish speciality filled with cheeses, fresh vegetables and olive tapenade.
sandwich_simit_acma.ing: The famous Istanbul sandwich: a sesame simit or soft açma filled with feta, melting kaşar cheese, tomatoes, lettuce and fragrant olive tapenade. Fresh, generous and full of Turkish flavours.

sandwich_tomate_mozza.name: Tomato mozzarella sandwich
sandwich_tomate_mozza.desc: A combination of tomato, mozzarella, basil and lettuce.
sandwich_tomate_mozza.ing: A sandwich all about freshness: juicy tomatoes, melting mozzarella, fragrant basil and crunchy lettuce in a soft roll. Italy meets Turkey in one bite.

sandwich_thon.name: Tuna sandwich
sandwich_thon.desc: Tuna sandwich with mayonnaise, hard-boiled egg, tomato and lettuce.
sandwich_thon.ing: A tasty sandwich of creamy tuna bound with mayonnaise, topped with hard-boiled egg, tomato and crunchy lettuce. Simple, fresh and filling.

sandwich_poulet_curry.name: Chicken curry sandwich
sandwich_poulet_curry.desc: Sandwich with curry-seasoned chicken, served with mayonnaise and lettuce.
sandwich_poulet_curry.ing: Tender chicken seasoned with mild curry, paired with smooth mayonnaise and crunchy lettuce. A fragrant, gently spiced sandwich.

sandwich_vegetarien.name: Vegetarian sandwich
sandwich_vegetarien.desc: A sandwich with grilled vegetables, nuts and cheese.
sandwich_vegetarien.ing: A generous sandwich of grilled vegetables — soft peppers, courgettes and aubergines — with crunchy walnuts and cheese (feta or cream cheese depending on the variant served).

borek_epinards.name: Spinach börek
borek_epinards.desc: Turkish-style savoury pastry filled with spinach.
borek_epinards.ing: A Turkish börek with golden, flaky pastry and a soft, lightly seasoned spinach filling. Hearty and flavourful — a perfect match for Turkish tea.

borek_pommes_terre.name: Potato börek
borek_pommes_terre.ing: A börek with golden, crispy pastry wrapped around a soft, comforting potato filling. A classic you'll find in every Istanbul bakery window.

borek_fromage.name: Cheese börek
borek_fromage.ing: A börek with crispy layered pastry hiding a heart of melted, stretchy cheese. Served warm: pure savoury indulgence.

borek_viande_hachee.name: Minced meat börek
borek_viande_hachee.desc: Savoury pastry filled with minced meat.
borek_viande_hachee.ing: A generously filled börek with Turkish-spiced minced meat inside golden, crispy pastry. Perfect for a savoury break on the go.

toast_kasar.name: Kaşar cheese toast
toast_kasar.ing: Toasted bread topped with Turkish kaşar cheese, melted until deliciously stretchy. Simple and irresistible, served piping hot.

toast_salami_fromage.name: Salami and cheese toast
toast_salami_fromage.ing: A crispy toast topped with salami and melting cheese, grilled until golden. The warm classic that makes the break.

toast_chorizo_fromage.name: Chorizo and cheese toast
toast_chorizo_fromage.ing: An indulgent toast with slightly spicy chorizo and melted cheese, grilled to perfection. A Spanish-Turkish pairing full of character.

toast_galista.name: Galista toast (Yengen)
toast_galista.ing: Our signature “Yengen” toast: melted kaşar cheese, grilled peppers and tomatoes on crispy toasted bread. The house speciality — not to be missed.

croissant_pain_chocolat.name: Croissant or pain au chocolat
croissant_pain_chocolat.ing: A golden, flaky viennoiserie: an all-butter croissant or a pain au chocolat with a soft chocolate heart. Crispy outside, tender inside.

croissant_framboise.name: Raspberry croissant
croissant_framboise.ing: A soft, fruity raspberry croissant — the perfect balance of indulgence and tangy freshness.

bretzel.name: Bretzel
bretzel.ing: The Alsatian bretzel with its glossy brown crust and coarse salt: soft in the middle, crispy on the outside. Strasbourg's must-have savoury treat.

bretzel_gratine.name: Cheese-topped bretzel
bretzel_gratine.ing: A bretzel gratinéed with cheese under a golden, stretchy layer. An even more indulgent version of the Alsatian classic.

simit_acma.name: Simit / açma
simit_acma.ing: The stars of the Turkish breakfast table: simit, the sesame-crusted ring bread, and açma, the soft twisted brioche. Enjoy them warm, plain or as a sandwich.

pain_raisins.name: Pain aux raisins
pain_raisins.ing: Crispy puff pastry rolled around a smooth cream filling with plump raisins. A classic viennoiserie that never disappoints.

chausson_pommes.name: Apple turnover
chausson_pommes.ing: A golden turnover of crispy flaky pastry with a soft, fragrant apple filling. Pure comfort.

suisse_torsade_triangle.name: Chocolate suisse, torsade or almond triangle
suisse_torsade_triangle.ing: Pick your viennoiserie: the chocolate suisse, the flaky torsade or the almond triangle. Three golden classics for a sweet break.

pogaca_fromage.name: Poğaça with cheese
pogaca_fromage.ing: The Turkish poğaça: a soft, golden little bun filled with melting cheese. The perfect savoury bite with Turkish tea or coffee.

salade_saison.name: Seasonal salad
salade_saison.ing: A crunchy seasonal salad: green salad, juicy cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, sweetcorn and grated carrots, finished with a balsamic dressing. Fresh and light.

salade_poulet.name: Chicken salad
salade_poulet.ing: A complete salad: green salad, cherry tomatoes, sweetcorn, grated carrots, golden croutons, parmesan and tender chicken, coated in a smooth Caesar dressing. A full meal in a bowl.

salade_thon.name: Tuna salad
salade_thon.ing: A fresh, filling salad: green salad, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, sweetcorn, olives and hard-boiled eggs, with tuna. Simple and generously loaded.

mini_macarons.name: Mini macarons
mini_macarons.ing: Delicate mini macarons with a smooth shell and a soft heart, in the flavours of the day. Gone in one or two bites.

cookies.name: Cookies
cookies.ing: A chocolate-chip cookie, crispy at the edges and soft at the centre. The perfect companion to a café latte.

muffin_pepites.name: Chocolate chip muffin
muffin_pepites.ing: A light, golden muffin generously studded with melting chocolate chips. Ideal for a sweet break.

muffin_maxi_choco.name: Maxi choco muffin
muffin_maxi_choco.ing: A generous, all-chocolate muffin — deeply cocoa-flavoured and wonderfully soft. For true chocolate lovers.

eclair_choco_vanille_cafe.name: Chocolate, vanilla or coffee éclair
eclair_choco_vanille_cafe.ing: An éclair of golden choux pastry filled with a smooth chocolate, vanilla or coffee cream and topped with a glossy glaze. French pastry elegance.

brownie.name: Brownie
brownie.ing: An intense chocolate brownie with a crackled top and a fudgy centre. Rich, dense and deeply chocolatey.

moka_cafe.name: Moka café
moka_cafe.ing: A coffee-and-chocolate pastry: moka flavours woven through a soft, fragrant dessert. Coffee lovers' pleasure, in sweet form.

mille_feuille.name: Mille-feuille
mille_feuille.ing: A classic mille-feuille: crispy layers of puff pastry alternating with velvety cream, crowned with fondant icing. French indulgence at its finest.

macarons_framboise.name: Raspberry macarons
macarons_framboise.ing: Raspberry macarons with a fine, crisp shell and a soft heart — fruity and tangy. The perfect union of sweetness and freshness.

glace_cone.name: Cone or tulip cup
glace_cone.ing: Our ice cream in a crispy cone or tulip: choose one, two or three scoops from fourteen flavours, from salted butter caramel to pistachio. A cool treat to enjoy on the go.

glace_pot.name: Tub
glace_pot.ing: Our ice cream in a tub, savoured with a spoon: one, two or three scoops from fourteen smooth flavours. A fresh break at your own pace.

glace_supplement.name: Extra whipped cream or coulis
glace_supplement.ing: Add a touch of indulgence to your ice cream: airy whipped cream or a fragrant fruit coulis.

milkshake.name: Milkshake
milkshake.ing: A smooth, velvety milkshake blended with the ice-cream flavour of your choice. Fresh, indulgent and irresistibly creamy.

espresso.name: Espresso
espresso.ing: An intense, velvety espresso, carefully extracted for a dense crema and balanced notes of cocoa and nuts. Served in a small cup to be savoured in a few sips.

double_espresso.name: Double espresso
double_espresso.ing: Our signature espresso in a double dose: twice the intensity, crema and aroma. For palates who like their coffee strong.

cafe_long.name: Long coffee
cafe_long.ing: A long black, softer and lighter than an espresso, revealing round, balanced notes. To be savoured slowly, on its own or with a pastry.

cafe_latte.name: Café latte
cafe_latte.ing: A soft, creamy coffee: a delicate espresso lengthened with velvety milk and a thin layer of foam. The perfect balance of coffee strength and milk smoothness.

cappuccino.name: Cappuccino
cappuccino.ing: The Italian classic: intense espresso crowned with a dense, velvety milk foam dusted with a touch of cocoa. Rich, round and comforting.

americano.name: Americano
americano.ing: An espresso topped up with hot water for a long, light and aromatic coffee. The choice of those who like a large cup with a gentle body.

latte_macchiato.name: Latte macchiato
latte_macchiato.ing: A latte macchiato served in a tall glass: velvety milk “stained” with intense espresso, in three distinct layers. Soft, creamy and a feast for the eyes.

cafe_turc.name: Turkish coffee
cafe_turc.ing: Turkish coffee brewed in a cezve: very finely ground, simmered slowly with water and sugar for a dense, fragrant coffee topped with a delicate foam. An Istanbul institution to sip slowly — right to the last sip (leaving the grounds behind!).

cafe_noisette.name: Café noisette
cafe_noisette.ing: An espresso touched with a dash of milk that gives it its “noisette” hazel hue. Soft and quick: the coffee for short but tasty breaks.

ice_coffee.name: Ice coffee
ice_coffee.ing: A fresh, refreshing coffee served well chilled over ice: all the comfort of coffee in a summer version. Ideal for sunny breaks.

ice_latte.name: Ice latte
ice_latte.ing: An iced latte: cold velvety milk over ice, “stained” with intense espresso. Creamy, soft and thirst-quenching all at once.

ice_cappuccino.name: Ice cappuccino
ice_cappuccino.ing: A cappuccino turned iced: intense espresso, cold milk and velvety foam over a bed of ice. The classic Italian foam, with extra freshness.

supplement_lait_avoine.name: Oat milk extra
supplement_lait_avoine.ing: Swap in or add oat milk to your drink: a gentle, lightly sweet plant-based alternative.

saveur_gourmande.name: Gourmet flavour extra
saveur_gourmande.ing: Add a gourmet flavour touch to your favourite hot drink: a fragrant syrup for an even softer break.

the_turc.name: Turkish tea
the_turc.ing: Traditional Turkish tea served in the famous tulip-shaped glass: black tea steeped slowly, amber-coloured and full-bodied. Sip it slowly, just like in Istanbul.

tisane_palais.name: Herbal tea by Palais des Thés
tisane_palais.ing: A delicate herbal infusion by Palais des Thés, with soft, soothing aromas. The comforting drink for wind-downs and quiet breaks.

lait_nature.name: Plain milk
lait_nature.ing: Plain milk, served hot or cold — simple and gentle. For the most delicate of breaks.

lait_miel.name: Milk with honey
lait_miel.ing: Warm honey milk, sweet and comforting: the honey slowly melting into the smooth milk. The ultimate cosy drink.

chocolat_chaud.name: Hot chocolate
chocolat_chaud.ing: An intense, velvety hot chocolate with a deep cocoa taste. A warm hug in a cup.

chocolat_chaud_lait.name: Hot chocolate with milk
chocolat_chaud_lait.ing: An even creamier hot chocolate, made with more milk for a light, silky texture. Soft and indulgent — loved by every age.

eau_cristaline_volvic.name: Water Cristaline / Volvic
eau_cristaline_volvic.ing: Still mineral water, Cristaline or Volvic, served well chilled. The ideal companion to your coffee or meal.

carola_rouge_verte.name: Carola red / green
carola_rouge_verte.ing: Carola mineral water, still or sparkling, served well chilled. Its fine, light bubbles pair beautifully with a coffee or a meal.

lemonaid_charitea.name: Lemonaid / Charitea
lemonaid_charitea.ing: An organic, fair-trade soft drink: Lemonaid with lemon, lime or passion fruit, or Charitea iced tea. Fresh, fruity and made with purpose.

jus_granini_pago.name: Granini / Pago fruit juice
jus_granini_pago.ing: A Granini or Pago fruit juice in the flavour of your choice, fruity and served well chilled.

sodas.name: Coca-Cola / Fanta / Sprite / Ice Tea
sodas.ing: The great soda classics: Coca-Cola, Fanta, Sprite or Ice Tea, served well chilled. The familiar fizz everyone loves.

red_bull.name: Red Bull
red_bull.ing: A well-chilled can of Red Bull for an energising boost in the middle of the day.

specialites.title: The essentials of Galista Café.
specialites.intro: From Turkish specialities to the great classics of coffee — here's what our guests love to come back for.

list.title: Turkish coffee
list.text: An institution to be sipped slowly, an emblem of oriental hospitality. Find it on our menu, on its own or as part of a gourmet break.

list.title: Cappuccinos & café lattes
list.text: Intense espresso, velvety milk and delicate foam: the great classics of coffee, carefully prepared.

list.title: Simit & açma
list.text: Turkish morning treats: sesame-crusted ring bread and a soft brioche — perfect at any time of day.

list.title: Böreks
list.text: Turkish-style savoury pastries: spinach, potato, cheese or minced meat.

list.title: Breakfasts
list.text: From the classic to the generous Galista breakfast: everything you need to start the day beautifully.

list.title: Pastries
list.text: Macarons, éclairs, mille-feuilles and brownies — a display case that calls for a break.

list.title: Ice cream & milkshakes
list.text: Fourteen listed flavours, from salted butter caramel to pistachio — in a cone, a tub or a milkshake.

contact.text: Come and see us at 46 rue du Faubourg-National in Strasbourg, or give us a call: we'll be delighted to welcome you.
